title: 363. 3Sum Smaller

examples.explanation: The triples ([-2,0,1]) and ([-2,0,3]) sum to -1 and 1, both below 2.
Fewer than three values means no triple exists.
Three of the four possible triples fall below 4.

hints: Sort the array so the two-pointer technique applies to each fixed first index.
When the current triple is below target, every index between the pointers pairs with the fixed index, adding that many triples at once.
